text:
Mira Chen: morning async — did KV-evict canary and alert dedupe tuning. Blocker: autoscaler flapping on small jobs, seeing ~5% 503s during ramp. Today: investigate autoscaler logs + follow up on PR for batcher warp.

Alex Park: :thumbsup: saw the canary, looks stable on my end. For autoscaler, can you paste pod events / error snippet? pinging @Sam R for oncall context.

Sam R: oncall-bot forwarded an alert earlier. I'm online and watching, will help correlate with tracing.

oncall-bot: [ALERT] autoscaler-churn-high — group A-23 created, severity: medium, affected: eu-west. Link: https://alerts.redwood.example/A-23

Lee Gomez: jumping in, pulling logs now: `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/autoscaler --since=15m` — I see repeated scale down + up loop, probable race with graceful termination.

Mira Chen: added full tarball of traces + events: /mnt/logs/ops/8712345678-autoscaler.tar.gz and a Dune dashboard: https://dune.redwood.example/ops/dash/7842

Alex Park: CR #4123: left a couple inline nits about KV warmup ordering, otherwise LGTM. Can someone approve so we can merge before EOD? If not, I'll hold off.

devops: quick heads-up — kernel patch rollout scheduled for eu-west at 02:00 UTC, will cause short pod restarts. Plan: maintenance window 02:00-02:15 UTC. We'll coordinate to avoid pager noise.

Sam R: ack, I'll mute autoscaler-low-critical during that window and re-enable after verification.

Mira Chen: thanks — no other blockers from me. If Lee spots the autoscaler race I'll add a follow-up ticket (SRE-389).
